items.title: General tutorial promises span separate ISOBASE requests
items.fresh_review_status: reproduced on N1 and N6
items.observation: #promise1 returns a reference, but #promise2 runs in a different stateless caller context. N1 reports an expired/unknown promise; N6 returns false. The example must keep promise and yield in one query for ISOBASE.

items.title: General tutorial grammar loading and generation do not match ISOBASE
items.fresh_review_status: reproduced on N1 and N6
items.observation: #dcg1 uses consult, which requires a retained session. N1 masks the missing load because its shared DB already contains s/3; N6 has no s/3. #dcg3 also uses writeln/1, which ISOBASE rejects. Use request-local source and a pure/paged generation query for ISOBASE, or state an ISOTOPE/ACTOR prerequisite.

items.title: General tutorial assumes actor helpers that are not loaded
items.fresh_review_status: reproduced on native N3/N4/N5 and SWI-WASM Worker; dedicated profile tutorials checked separately
items.observation: The general tutorial says fridge/1, store/3, take/3 and ping_pong/0 are already provided by the node. The general-page calls encounter missing predicates on native nodes as well as SWI-WASM Worker. Supply explicit source loading; browser readers can also use the dedicated SWI-WASM tutorial. Linda explicitly requires N3/N4/N5 and is a documented prerequisite, not a browser runtime bug.

items.title: General tutorial source loads invalidate later live actor bindings
items.fresh_review_status: reproduced on native N3/N4; missing toplevel binding also observed on N5 and Worker
items.observation: The expert-agent source Load occurs between toplevel input examples and the later $Pid loop/abort/halt examples, clearing that prerequisite. The fridge2 source Load replaces the session after the server/supervisor has started, retiring the actors and clearing $Sup; subsequent server_upgrade and requests have no fridge actor. Keep each live-actor sequence together and load both server implementations before spawning.

coverage.alias: statechart-behaviour-tutorial redirects to the ACTOR statechart chapter

interpretation: This is an exercise review, not a claim of complete language conformance or a proof that no bugs remain.

Hidden controls and unavailable catalogue examples are recorded as exclusions. Native-only movie data and Linda prerequisites are respected. Model/Jev services are exercised on N3 as prescribed; Linda uses two sessions on each of N3/N4/N5.

Infinite clock/ping-pong/output examples and deliberately waiting receives are observed then bounded; paged generators are sampled. Exhaustive answer enumeration and arbitrary actor interleavings are outside this run.

Deliberate bad calls, invalid sleep arguments, failing timeout callbacks, profile boundary errors and post-termination cleanup are expected outcomes. Alternate menu paths after a chart has terminated need a new spawn; resulting missing-Pid observations are not claimed as passing scenarios.

A runner double-Abort artifact was discarded and the Main ACTOR tutorial rerun with the actual one-Abort exercise sequence. A hidden-first-control wait was corrected and all three native general tutorial pages rerun.
